name: Ian Nunes Valença
headline: Scientific figures from viral metagenomics, phylogenetics, and spatial epidemiology.
bio: I am a postdoctoral researcher in computational biology at the University of Tübingen. I completed my PhD in Infectious Diseases at the University of São Paulo and Imperial College London, where I studied nanopore metagenomics for respiratory virus detection and genomic surveillance. This site gathers the best data visualizations, maps, phylogenies, and analytical schematics I created across my doctoral thesis and published research.
